shortDescription: 20.19.0.v202611181947 (Deluxe) for CyberLink 9 Languages + RUS + PTB (Enu, Cht, Chs, Jpn, Kor, Deu, Esp, Fra, Ita, Rus, Ptb) (R5)

env.account: Not signed in (Free; Premium by the debug switch where a bug needed it)
env.testedBy: AI agent (Claude Opus 5.5) driving the phone over Appium; verdicts and evidence reviewed by WILLY_WU
env.install: TR build 20.19.0.v202611181947 (versionCode 90201901, SR PHA261029-01), installed 2026/11/19 over the previous build; app data cleared once on 2026/11/19 16:00 to remove a Swipe Collage draft that crashed on open
env.scope: every eBug on this TR's verify list (PHD-A rule)

observations: Swipe Collage: after the app was closed with a Swipe Collage canvas open, every later 「Try Swipe Collage!」 crashed the app (ClassCastException in SwipeCollageDraftUseCase load) until the app data was cleared.

AI Hair Color Custom: the Intensity bar shows on the result only; the panel itself has no Intensity row (today's spec R-041 rests on open question Q-4; the PM comment RD cites draws it on the result).
AI Hair Color Custom: before a style is chosen the colour-wheel key keeps full colour while disabled.
Swipe Collage text Color picker: a colour cancelled with Back is still added as a recent swatch.

rows.title: PHD-A 19.12.0 - [UX]Artistic_Avatar: There is no place to show the remain credits in the result page
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: The Artistic Avatar result page now shows the remaining credits.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.15.0 - AI_Replace: The preview is not change to new image after tapping the [Create More] button
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: After picking another AI Replace artwork, Replace More now opens AI Replace with that artwork's image.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.15.0 - My_AI_Artwork: The button is showing "Create More" instead of "Replace More"
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: The AI Replace tab in My AI Artwork now shows 「Replace More」.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Batch_Editing: AI Enhance does not pause in the background; remaining photos fail as Connection lost
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: Batch AI Enhance now pauses while the app is in the background and continues on return until every photo is enhanced.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Batch_Editing: System Back does not close the AI Enhance confirm dialog 「Enhance 12 photos?」
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: System Back now closes the 「Enhance 12 photos?」 dialog like Cancel and nothing is processed.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Batch_Editing: System Back does not close the 「Discard changes?」 dialog opened from Home
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: System Back now closes the 「Discard changes?」 dialog like Keep Editing and the edits are kept.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Batch_Editing: Square crop applied to all saves a 16:9 photo as 1434 x 1435, not square
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: Square crop applied to all now saves the 16:9 photo with equal width and height.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Swipe_Collage: 「Lock」 on the image tool bar does nothing; the photo can still be moved
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: Lock now locks the photo: it can no longer be dragged or zoomed in its frame, and the floating lock unlocks it.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Swipe_Collage: 「Removal」 on the image tool bar opens nothing
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: Removal now opens the Object Removal room with the frame's photo, for both Premium and Free users.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Swipe_Collage: System Back on the Custom color picker applies the colour instead of cancelling
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: System Back now closes only the Custom color picker and the picked colour is not applied.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent][UI] Swipe_Collage: Pages move button selects on a tap; dragging shows no enlarged page or hint
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: A tap on the Pages move button still selects the page; dragging now lifts the page enlarged and translucent but shows no hint.
rows.observed: Tapping the move button under a page still selects that page (orange frame, Insert Left / Insert Right / Delete enabled). Dragging now lifts the page enlarged, tilted and translucent, but no 「Hold ≡ & drag to reorder」 hint appears.
rows.observedZh: 點頁面下方的移動鈕仍會選取該頁；拖曳時頁面已放大、傾斜、半透明，但沒有出現拖曳提示文字。
rows.expected: Tapping the move button should do nothing; only dragging it should reorder the page, with the hint shown.
rows.expectedZh: 點移動鈕不應選取頁面；只有拖曳才排序，並顯示提示文字。

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent][UI] Swipe_Collage: Pages controls overlap from 5 pages; at 10 only the last ••• can be reached
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: At 5 and 10 pages every page's move and ••• buttons are drawn apart and each opens the right page.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent][UI] Swipe_Collage: Template cards read 「1 pages」 and Save & Share reads 「1 images」
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: One-page template cards now read 「1 page」 and the one-page Save & Share no longer shows 「1 images」.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] AI_Hair_Color: Custom panel: colour rows can be picked before any style is chosen
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: Before a style is chosen, the Custom panel's colour rows and Generate are now disabled.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] AI_Hair_Color: Custom colour palette has no eyedropper key next to the hue slider
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: The Custom colour palette now has an eyedropper key right of the hue slider and it picks a colour from the photo.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] AI_Hair_Color: System Back in the colour palette leaves AI Hair Color, not just the palette
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: System Back in the colour palette now closes only the palette like Cancel and stays in AI Hair Color.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] AI_Hair_Color: Collapsing Custom panel keeps Soft Black selected; Generate makes a template
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: Collapsing the Custom panel now keeps Custom selected, and the outer Generate makes a Custom result with the chosen colours.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] AI_Hair_Color: Custom result has no Intensity bar, panel open or collapsed
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: The Custom result now shows an Intensity bar at 100 above Retry and it can be dragged.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] AI_Hair_Color: First Custom result shows no one-time My AI Artwork 100% dialog
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: On a cleared install the first Custom result still shows no one-time My AI Artwork 100% dialog.
rows.observed: With the app data cleared, the first Custom result shows with Intensity 100 and no one-time dialog; none appears on dragging Intensity, closing the panel or the second Custom result either.
rows.observedZh: 清除 App 資料後，第一次 Custom 結果仍沒有出現一次性對話框；拖曳 Intensity、收合面板與第二次結果時也都沒有。
rows.expected: A one-time dialog should say My AI Artwork keeps only the 100% version, with Don't show again.
rows.expectedZh: 應出現一次性對話框說明 My AI Artwork 只保存 100% 版本，並有「不再顯示」。

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] AI_Hair_Color: Tapping Custom after a template result does not bring back the Custom result
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: After a template result, tapping Custom now brings back the Custom result with no new charge.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [UX]Reel_Creator: The mask is not covering the preview below the [Use Template] button
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: In Reel Creator Preview the mask now covers the preview below 「Use Template」.
